resources.string: Private by design. Anonymous by default.
No phone number. No email. No contact book sync. End-to-end encrypted conversations and calls controlled solely by you.
Enter your PIN or use biometrics to decrypt your workspace.
Disappearing messages delete locally on both devices, but cannot prevent screenshots or external recordings.
Secret Spaces do not appear in your Spaces list. If you forget the secret passphrase, data inside cannot be recovered.
